This week, I asked for unanimous passage of my Stop Insider Trading Act.  Senate Democrats blocked it – again.

This bill would prevent congressional insider trading. Members wouldn’t be able to buy stocks while in office.  It would also require Members to disclose plans to sell stock to the public seven days in advance.

It’s commonsense legislation to restore integrity in Congress. We need to pass it into law.
posts.summary: Calls for insider trading ban, criticizes Democratic blockade

Today, we are honoring the life and legacy of Lindsey Graham.
 
Lindsey was a friend and patriot. He stood up for freedom at home and around the world. We will continue to miss him and his commitment to making our nation better.
posts.summary: Praises deceased senator Graham's patriotism and commitment to freedom
posts.quote:
Today, we are honoring the life and legacy of Lindsey Graham.
 
Lindsey was a friend and patriot. He stood up for freedom at home and around the world. We will continue to miss him and his commitment to making our nation better.

posts.text:
One way the Senate is honoring him is by meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
 
Lindsey was a tireless supporter of Ukraine’s right to defend its people and homeland in the face of Russia’s unprovoked aggression.  He knew that allowing Putin to win would threaten American lives.
 
Today’s meeting sends a clear message to Putin – America stands with Ukraine. The world is safer when Putin loses.
